text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
! I got it! You don't count the ones where 
the tens digit becomes 0!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! I got tripped up on that before 
too. You have to be careful with zeros in 
combinatorics problems.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Eye-san. You're great at 
teaching too. Looks like I won't make 
mistakes on the next test either.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, stop flattering me. You understood it 
from the very beginning, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Eye-chan, teach me too~!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Of course! But did you try solving it on 
your own at least once? You have to do 
that first!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Pass! Over here!
(Tweet!)

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Nice shot, Eye-chan! Your form was 
perfect, practically pro-level!

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text:
She's been watching pro training videos 
lately to prepare! Doing that just for 
class is way too impressive~.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you! ...Now, let's keep this 
momentum going and take the win!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, that's it for today's sports 
science class. You can spend the rest of 
the time as free time!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
! Lala, Eye! It's free time! Let's play a 
juggling contest!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
A juggling contest? ...Sounds fun, 
challenge accepted!

While heading to the training grounds for 
afternoon practice...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
choice_data_list: Hm? I wonder what they're doing?

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text: Yay! Boo got first place again!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, one more time! Let's do one more! 
I've got the hang of it now, so this time 
for sure...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
You say that, but... Blast-san is quite 
the veteran when it comes to ball games, 
ya know? And besides—
(Ding dong dang dong)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, but time's up. We'd better tidy 
up quick and head to afternoon training.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ngh! ...You're right. Understood.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Then Blast, tomorrow! Tomorrow, let's do 
this again!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I fully understand how skilled you are. 
...But I hate leaving things on a loss!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let me keep challenging you until I win! 
Please!
choice_data_list:
(Until she wins... She must be really 
frustrated.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...My, my, looks like there's actual fire 
in her eyes. Scary, scary.

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Boo is totally fine with that, of course! 
I'm so happy I get to play lots with you, 
Eye!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Blast! —Next time, I won't 
lose!
